_notice: Deterministic scenario definitions / invariants. Agent should translate to automated tests plus clickable debug fixtures.

scenarios.given: adventurer A becomes statue at sim_hour=100 in dungeon; adventurer B at same hour in occupied frontier tower
scenarios.when: advance both to hour 819 without safe retrieval, then to hour 820
expect: At 819 both remain eligible for retrieval regardless of original location
At exactly 820 both become permanently solidified
No bunker/structure exception to exposure time

scenarios.given: adventurer A statues at hour 100 and is safely retrieved at hour 700
scenarios.when: advance to hour 900 while treatment is queued
expect: A remains retrievable/reversible; 30-day threshold only applies while unrecovered
Treatment cost is based on elapsed abandoned time at hour 700, not hour 900

scenarios.given: stable frontier, miracle charge=1, eight deployed; six become statues and two escape
scenarios.when: frontier gate falls; choose three statues for goddess intervention
expect: Miracle charge becomes 0
Chosen three adventurers immediately regain combat-ready state, not statues
Other three remain unrecovered with original formed_at
Invasion banished and phase becomes DIVINE_EMERGENCY
Production impaired
Phase becomes SANCTUARY_SIEGE
No extra divine resurrection
Outside production stops

scenarios.given: phase SANCTUARY_SIEGE, stocks nonzero, surviving reserve roster
scenarios.when: sanctuary siege wins, spend rebuild cost/time, auto-retrieve eligible frontier casualties, restore selected adventurers, lose frontier breakthrough
expect: After siege win: COUNTEROFFENSIVE_PREPARATION, extended time interval
After rebuild: FRONTIER_BREAKTHROUGH and eligible frontier statues safely returned but not revived
After breakthrough loss: SANCTUARY_SIEGE again, with depleted stocks
Phase becomes STABLE_FRONTIER
Cleared production access restored
miracle recharge counter is 0

scenarios.given: phase STABLE_FRONTIER after crisis, miracle charge 0, recharge counter 0, production operational
expect: After first win counter=1 and charge=0
After second win counter=2 and charge=1
Additional wins cannot stack charges above 1

scenarios.given: stable frontier charge=0 and no successful invasions during time skip
expect: No miracle charge from waiting
Scheduled invasions must resolve rather than silently being skipped

scenarios.given: adventurer A assigned to active dungeon party
scenarios.when: try to assign A to tower during same simulated time
expect: Assignment rejected or expedition return required first
No duplicate of A

scenarios.given: one stratum boss alive, discovery points recorded
expect: Stratum marked secure
Auto extraction enabled
Ambient ward upkeep still required
No routine wave defense scheduled for that old stratum

scenarios.given: one combat-ready adventurer, limited stockpile, multiple rescued statues, sanctuary just held
scenarios.when: try to rebuild and restore enough for frontline breakthrough
expect: At least one documented non-free path remains mechanically reachable in configured debug fixture
If not, balance parameters/fixture need changes, not invisible free healing
Phase becomes GAME_OVER
No miraculous third-state rescue
Game can reload prior save

scenarios.given: secured deposit and insufficient ward energy
expect: Production halts
Workers do not automatically become statues from being forced to work unprotected
No free material output

scenarios.given: unrecovered statues, next invasion in 15 hours, active treatment and one defender assigned to a structure
expect: All IDs, event times, deadlines, stocks and assignments preserved exactly
No resource duplication or time loss
